title: chore: remove unavailable community apps
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:

- Removes 30 catalog rows representing 30 approved review targets.
- Keeps 60 apps whose checks were inconclusive (timeouts, 5xx, 403/429); only definite markers count as dead.
- Does not change retained-app metadata or screenshots.

gist.headline: A little catalog pruning
gist.blurb: The app catalog got a careful trim: 30 unavailable or duplicate listings are out, while 60 apps with inconclusive checks stay put. No guessing based on a timeout.
gist.summary: Removed 30 app catalog rows with definite evidence of unavailable or duplicate targets, while retaining 60 apps whose checks returned timeouts, 5xx, or 403/429 responses.
gist.impact: People browsing the catalog will encounter fewer dead or duplicate listings; apps with inconclusive checks keep their listings, metadata, and screenshots.
gist.visual_concept: Depict the community app catalog as a cozy garden of distinct app tiles. Polli, wearing a tiny gardener's hat, gently prunes duplicate and unavailable tiles while leaving uncertain ones growing; a lime-green glow marks the garden.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art app garden, Polli gently tends distinct app tiles and sets duplicate tiles aside, leaving uncertain sprouts untouched; she is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, small rounded light blue translucent wings, and a tiny gardener's hat, small-to-medium in the scene and strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients over warm cream with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, chunky sprites and gentle CRT glow, with dark purple (#110518) outlines; nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
